propositions: Three independent implementations of detached rebar child spawning exist across push.py, enrich_drain.py, and compact_trigger.py, duplicating PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, cwd handling, and stdio discipline
Bug 3198-438c-72a5-470f (missing cwd parameter) propagated to all three detached spawn sites via copy-paste imitation, demonstrating structural risk of property changes affecting multiple locations
A fourth detached spawn site in gc_trigger.py replicated the same signature pattern while the consolidation was under review, confirming the need for static enforcement
spawn_detached helper must consolidate the three (later four) sites into a single stdlib-only leaf implementation while preserving per-caller exception handling and environment construction postures
Static source scan test must enforce that DETACHED_PROCESS, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, and the sys.path.insert re-entry bootstrap appear only in _proc.py
repo_root fallback posture for long-lived in-process callers (daemon threads, reconcilers) must be documented and decided, independent of detached child cwd anchoring
